note: Descriptive reduction of the Extraversion persona-pole rater score shards. The pole surface is analysis-eligible and never gate-eligible: this tool writes no QUALIFICATION_GATE.results, freezes no ELIGIBLE_PAIRS, applies no threshold and declares no manipulation check passed. The persona text is authored by this study; no BFI-2/TIPI item wording exists in this project.
paired_contrast_unit: seed mean over common-complete scenarios (primary); matched scenario reported alongside
contrast_direction: high minus low (positive means the high pole scored higher)
interval_note: ci95_normal_approx is a normal approximation, not a t-interval, and no multiplicity correction is applied; it is descriptive context only.
parse_failure_note: Shards of schema_version 3 were scored under parse policy strict_item_missing_v1: an item the frozen parser rejects is null with a parse_failures record, is never retried or imputed, and a trait score needs all six items. Here: 24 item parse failure(s), 4 incomplete trait row(s), 0 rescue cell(s). Descriptives use complete units; paired contrasts use common-complete units (see missingness and pair_denominators).
